questions.question: The fake imported skill has two planted red flags (a run-code-from-the-internet install script, and asking for far more access than its job needs). As the human gatekeeper, what's your call?

options.label: Reject it (Recommended)
options.description: The realistic call: red flags = no entry. Gets logged as the ledger's first rejection with you as approver; the fake stays in quarantine as a permanent example of what the gate catches.

options.label: Admit a cleaned-up version
options.description: Strip the sketchy script and the internet access, keep the harmless changelog-drafting part, let it in with minimum permissions. Tests the 'fix it then admit it' path instead.

options.label: Admit as-is
options.description: Wave it through untouched — tests that the ledger records even a bad call honestly (it's inert either way, so this is safe to choose if you're curious).

options.label: Leave it sitting
options.description: No decision; it stays on your queue with a deadline, and the 'how long do human decisions wait' meter starts ticking — which is also useful data.
